name: Danganronpa: Gacha Life!
source:
Kaiya, along with 15 other ultimate students, is enrolled in a prestigious school: Gacha Academy. However, those teenagers aren't allowed to enjoy a sweet high school life - they are kidnapped and get stuck in a school building. At the same time, they are informed that they will stay here forever, unless... they kill someone.

[From [url=https://fishiesenpai.itch.io/danganronpa-gacha-life]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Kaiya和其他15名终极学生一起就读于一所著名学校：嘎查学院。然而，这些青少年并没有被允许享受甜蜜的高中生活——他们被绑架并被困在教学楼里。与此同时，他们被告知，他们将永远留在这里，除非……他们杀了人。

[来自[url=https://fishiesenpai.itch.io/danganronpa-gacha-life]itch.io[/url]]
